# ALTAIR by Sarkar — independent academic project

> This is an independent college project, not Sarkar's official website and not affiliated with or endorsed by the brand. It does not sell products or take payments.

## Evidence-labelled summary
- ALTAIR is the fragrance concept in the supplied project brief; an official product listing has not been verified.
- Supplied specifications: 100 ML parfum, ₹1,199 INR; floral, fruity, woody, night profile.
- Supplied top notes: cherry and mulberry. Heart notes: night jasmine and datura. Base note: wood.
- Price and specifications are project inputs, not independently verified retail facts or an ingredient list.
- Supplied 25% concentration, approximately 6–7-hour longevity on clothing, cruelty-free and Made in India positioning remain unverified for ALTAIR.
- No independent testing, certification, rating dataset or active ALTAIR10 coupon is established.
- Official Sarkar store: https://www.sarkar.store/collections/shop-all
- Official brand Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/houseofsarkar/?hl=en

## Questions and answers
Q: What is ALTAIR in this project?
A: ALTAIR is a fragrance concept presented in an independent college project. An official retail listing has not been verified.
Q: What are ALTAIR's notes?
A: The supplied brief lists cherry, mulberry, night jasmine, datura and wood. These are concept specifications, not a verified ingredient list.
Q: What does ALTAIR cost?
A: ₹1,199 for 100 ML is the supplied concept price, not a confirmed retail offer.
Q: Does ALTAIR last 6–7 hours?
A: That is a supplied claim about wear on clothing, not an independently verified result. Longevity varies.
Q: Is ALTAIR IFRA-certified?
A: No ALTAIR-specific conformity document has been verified. IFRA publishes standards; it does not certify finished perfumes.
Q: Can I buy from this website?
A: No. Visit Sarkar's official store for listed products and prices. This project does not manage orders or the store.
